metadata.short_desc: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance announcement bot
metadata.desc: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance (蓝色协议：星痕共鸣) official announcement bot — announcement list with paging and categories, latest announcement with summary and a phone-sized long image, per-group dedup, and scheduled auto-push (checked every 5 minutes). Includes a web panel to manage push targets by group name, trigger a push manually and browse the image gallery.

news_groups.description: Groups that receive scheduled Blue Protocol announcement pushes (group id or unified_msg_origin, multiple allowed)
news_groups.hint: Alternatively send "bp push on" in a group, or tick groups by name in the plugin panel (recommended). Empty means no automatic push.

list_page_size.description: Announcements per page in the list command
list_page_size.hint: How many rows "bp list" returns at once. Use an integer between 1 and 30.

shot_enabled.description: Render announcements as a phone-sized long image
shot_enabled.hint: When enabled the announcement body is rendered into a long image; when disabled (or on failure) it falls back to the dark card image.

shot_max_height.description: Maximum long-image height (CSS pixels, 0 = no limit)
shot_max_height.hint: Very long announcements are cut at this height and the text message points to the link.

shot_quality.hint: Lower saves bandwidth. Images above 2.5MB are downscaled automatically.

blueprotocol-panel.title: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance — Announcements
blueprotocol-panel.description: Manage push targets by group name, trigger a push manually, browse long images and push records; use the top-right button to switch between English and Chinese.

blueprotocol-panel.title: Blue Protocol: Star Resonance — Announcements
blueprotocol-panel.description: Manage push targets by group name, trigger a push manually, browse long images and push records; use the top-right button to switch between English and Chinese.

bp_latest.description: Newest announcement (summary text + phone-sized long image)

bp_latest_dedup.description: Newest announcement (only replies when there is something new, per-group dedup)

bp_push.description: Toggle automatic announcement push for this group (checked every 5 minutes)

bp_reset.description: Clear this group's announcement push record
